question: What form and place are assigned to the eighteen-armed Durgā?
premises: The verse names a lotus-endowed place.
It names worship of Durgā in your form.
inference: This verse assigns an eighteen-armed, full-breasted, armed, thighed Durgā form in a lotus-endowed place.
uncertainties: Compound boundaries are not fully resolved.
plain_english: There in a lotus-endowed place, worship Durgā in your form, eighteen-armed, full-breasted, armed, thighed.
